caption: The drawing depicts a single stone object positioned vertically against a neutral, lightly textured background. The stone is elongated with a rounded top and a wider base. The upper portion of the stone features intricate carvings with an arched design resembling two central draped forms that part in the middle, exposing a set of steps or ridges within. Flanking these central drapery-like features are symmetrical patterns comprised of branch or vine shapes with pointed arches and teardrop-shaped openings. The lower part of the stone is uncarved and has a rough, irregular texture, resembling natural rock. The entire object is rendered in muted earthy tones, mainly grays and browns, with subtle greenish and purplish tints enhancing the shaded areas. The artist’s signature, “Rose Campbell Gerke,” is inscribed in small, neat letters near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Stone Gate Post
